claims.statement: Actor, UDI/device, notified-body/certificate and market-surveillance EUDAMED modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026.
Manufacturers must submit UDI/device information for devices placed on the EU market.
Demand hypothesis: micro-manufacturers will pay for data preflight because label, certificate and registry inconsistencies can delay a release.

contrary_evidence: Regulatory consultancies and specialist UDI software already address this workflow.
Manufacturers with small catalogues may use Commission training and enter records manually.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: contract manufacturers and label vendors introduce the service when a device is prepared for production
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 300 manufacturers averaging 24000 PLN annual recurring revenue plus onboarding could exceed 7m PLN ARR and support founder equity above 5m PLN in 5-7 years
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours weekly with a contracted MDR/IVDR specialist
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 70-85% as field validation automates while regulatory exceptions remain reviewed
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 8-14 months with twenty active device families
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 8000-30000 PLN onboarding plus 500-2000 PLN per device family monthly
economics.retention_or_repeat: New devices, packaging levels, UDI changes, certificates and post-market corrections

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned validation corpus of field dependencies, authority feedback and version lineage reduces repeat errors
fingerprint.customer: Small EU medical-device and IVD manufacturers with modest regulatory teams
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Bundled through contract manufacturers, UDI-label vendors and boutique regulatory consultancies
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Structured data preflight and release workspace sold per device family with managed exception review
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Manufacturer pays per device-family onboarding, validated release and recurring catalogue maintenance
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A device or label version is released after mandatory EUDAMED modules require consistent UDI and actor data

founder_fit: Health and biosignal background improves domain comprehension
Data validation and entity resolution are core strengths
Partner-led workflow avoids camera or influencer dependence
risks: Medical-device errors carry material regulatory and patient-safety consequences.
Scope creep into regulated consulting must be controlled.
Sensitive device and certificate information requires strong security.

structure.control_point: UDI master-record approval before label printing and EUDAMED submission
structure.critical_dependency: Manufacturer-authorised access, accurate regulatory inputs and partner consultants who retain legal judgment

thesis: A UDI data-validation and submission-preparation desk embedded with medical-device contract manufacturers and regulatory consultants could block label release until EUDAMED actor, device, certificate and nomenclature fields reconcile. Manufacturers retain responsibility and submit through authorised accounts. Demand and economics are hypotheses.
title: EUDAMED UDI Release Desk for Micro-Manufacturers
uncertainties: Submission correction frequency after mandatory adoption
Best device class for a narrow pilot
